about_the_game:
■What is Magical Animals?

"Magical Animals" is a single-player 3D simulation game built around the concept of "forever experiencing the thrill and excitement when encountering powerful foes." Players aim to exterminate demons alongside their animals to save the world.

■Weapon Get and Loss System

The strength of enemies heavily depends on the weapons you possess. When you defeat an enemy, you can acquire their weapon, meaning the stronger the enemy you encounter, the more exciting the game system becomes, making you think, "If I defeat them, I can get that weapon!"

However, if you are defeated, the weapon equipped by your animal will be lost and fall into the enemy's hands. This system allows you to enjoy battles with constant tension.

■Battle

Players form a party of up to 5 animals to challenge battles. During party formation, you can choose "Vanguard," "Mid-guard," or "Rearguard" for each animal, which significantly changes their stats.

Additionally, each animal and enemy has unique characteristics and behavioral tendencies, greatly influencing the flow of battle.

From the infinite combinations of "Animals × Equipment × Party Formation," you can create a party with your favorite concept.
